question: Who among the following related to Patiala gharana?

options.text: Fateh Ali Khan and Ali Baksh Khan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fateh Ali Khan and Ali Baksh Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fateh Ali Khan and Ali Baksh Khan** are associated with the **Patiala Gharana**.
 
• The Patiala Gharana is one of the prominent schools of classical music in India, known for its unique style and contributions to Hindustani classical music.
